title: psp_helper windowed-dataset manifest.json (Core, CONTRACT_VERSION 1.0)
description: Schema for the '<X>.raw.manifest.json' sidecar written by build_windows_manifest. A reserved-keys policy applies: unknown top-level keys are permitted (additive MINOR changes must not break old validators), so 'additionalProperties' is intentionally NOT false at the top level.

shape.description: Windowed array shape (n windows, l samples per window, f channels).

feature_hash.description: sha256 hex of the newline-joined feature_names (see io/feature_meta + windows/manifest.feature_hash_from_meta).

config_fingerprint.description: The recorded, self-describing generation parameters. Geometry (window_length, step_length_seconds) is a RECORDED PARAMETER, not a frozen constant; l MUST equal round(window_length * sampling_frequency).

sampling_frequency.description: Hz. Recommended so l=round(W*fs) is checkable from the manifest alone.

contract_version.description: The CONTRACT_VERSION this dataset was written against (semver). Added in Core 1.0.

profile.description: Named SPEC profile this dataset conforms to, e.g. 'PROTECT-90' or 'EvEMTBench-v0.2'.
